'''Yahi'i''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] with stalks that could be easily cut down when they were ripe.<ref name="Twilight" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> while near the [[Zi-Zhinn Marketplace]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] thought that a group of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] he was [[Skirmish in Zi-Zhinn Marketplace|fighting]] would cut him down like a ripe yahi'i stalk if he attempted to retreat.<ref name="Twilight" />

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Yahi'i plant was first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Twilight" /> On [[March]] [[March 11|11]], [[2011]],<ref name="Airdate">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode320.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Citadel Rescue}}</ref> "[[Citadel Rescue]]," an episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] Even Piell's [[Death/Legends|death]] to occur in the episode,<ref name="Citadel">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref> instead of the novel,<ref name="Twilight" /> making it ambiguous how the events of the novel fit in with the altered continuity.
